mainEntity.name: What is a good dead hang time?

acceptedAnswer.text: A useful starting point is a controlled hold you can repeat without pain. Use 10, 30 or 60 seconds as personal milestones if they suit you, not as population averages. Compare repeat tests under the same conditions.

mainEntity.name: How long should a 40-year-old be able to dead hang?

acceptedAnswer.text: The sources cited here do not establish a required time for a 40-year-old. Training experience, bodyweight, grip, bar and assistance all affect the task. Record your own baseline instead of treating an age table as a pass or fail.

mainEntity.name: Is a two-minute dead hang good?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two minutes is a sustained hold, but this site cannot assign it a verified population percentile. It is not necessary to reach two minutes before a session counts as useful practice.
